about_the_game:
From the mid-21st century onward, over the next 50 to 150 years, humanity evolved into an interstellar civilization amid both conflict and cooperation between the two major powers, known as the Crimson and Azure Factions. The legendary Mars Project achieved such remarkable success that when the Helium Flash Crisis threatened existence, humanity achieved the impossible: They relocated Mars to Proxima Centauri, leaving Earth to dwell forever as an eternal homeland in memory.

As human civilization expanded throughout the Milky Way, evolving into what would be revered as the Galactic Tribe, an apocalyptic catastrophe emerged. In this twilight hour, humanity launched the " Huntian StarTrace Project" preserving the entirety of human legacy within colossal "Ark Motherships," and sending them into the depths of the unknown...

At the edge of the known universe, the last of these Arks drifted into a binary system—a strange and sublime merging of the Solar and Proxima Centauri systems. There, the orbit of the 8th planet's moon, disaster struck without warning. The massive ring-shaped space station, known as "Huntian," detached from the mothership, and the "Ring of Power" plunged onto the surface of the planet below...

You are the last remnant of humankind. Stranded on an untamed alien world, you must build a refuge, safeguard the dying ember of humanity, and ascend once more from oblivion to greatness. Sing the fragments of the "Ring of Power," you will retrace the path of civilization—from raw survival to reclaiming fire, from domesticating beasts & growing crops to harnessing steam and new energies... until you command the star-forged might of nuclear fusion. Only then can you rekindle the mothership’s artificial sun and journey back through the light-years to the blue planet.

Roam hazardous yet magnificent worlds, race across open plains, navigate treacherous valleys, dense alien forests, and unpredictable lakes—every step demands vigilance, every moment brings a fight or a revelation. Stay curious, but ready.

Here, life is relentless and adaptive—a vibrant tapestry of rich and bizarre ecosystems brimming with vitality. Study creature behaviors to avoid threats, gather rare resources under extreme conditions, and interact with the planet. Every discovery deepens your bond with this world.

With the Planetary Control Module, establish your stronghold and reshape the terrain. Craft, construct, power your infrastructure, and illuminate your beacon through the long nights. Here, at the edge of the unknown cosmos, forge a world that is truly your own—your homeland, your paradise among the stars.

What bridges the past and the future? What is the foundation of civilization?

Monuments of human civilization—a pilgrimage through time…

Rendered in a luminous, neo-minimalist visual style, this experience reimagines Eastern tradition through a futuristic vision. Here, humanity and advanced technology converge—shaping a world where culture and innovation reflect one another. Write your own legend within this vast, unfolding narrative…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX960
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Welcome to this innovative sci-fi open-world! As the last survivor of humanity, build a home on a wild alien planet. Reignite civilization—from primal survival to advanced energy systems. Use the Planetary Control Module to reshape the world, uncover human secrets, and journey back to Earth.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
